    let v := path.getD (i+1) 0

inductive GoodPath (nums : List Nat) : Nat → List Nat → Prop where
  | single {i : Nat} :
      i = nums.length - 1 →
      i < nums.length →
      GoodPath nums i [i]
  | cons {i j : Nat} {path : List Nat} :
      i < j →
      j ≤ i + nums.getD i 0 →
      GoodPath nums j path →
      GoodPath nums i (i :: path)

def canReachFuel (nums : List Nat) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, i => decide (i = nums.length - 1)
  | fuel + 1, i =>
      if i = nums.length - 1 then
        true
      else
        (List.range (nums.getD i 0)).any fun d =>
          let j := i + (d + 1)
          decide (j < nums.length) && canReachFuel nums fuel j

theorem list_any_eq_true_iff {α : Type} (xs : List α) (p : α → Bool) :
    xs.any p = true ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ p x = true := by

  | nil =>

      constructor

    (h : valid_path_from start path nums) : GoodPath nums start path := by

      subst a

      ∃ path, GoodPath nums i path ∧ path.length ≤ fuel + 1 := by

  | zero =>
      intro i h
      simp [canReachFuel] at h
      have hi : i < nums.length := by omega
      exact ⟨[i], GoodPath.single h hi, by simp⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>

        refine ⟨i :: path, GoodPath.cons ?_ ?_ hg, ?_⟩
        · omega
        · omega
        · simp

      | cons hij hle htail =>

          simp at hlen
          omega

        | single hlast' hi =>

            simp [canReachFuel, hlast]

              (fun d =>
                let jj := i + (d + 1)
                decide (jj < nums.length) && canReachFuel nums fuel jj)).mpr
            let d := j - i - 1

              dsimp [d]
              omega

                dsimp [d]
                omega

                simp at hlen
                omega

              simp [hjlt, hrec]
